answer: The extra fee on your booking is for an extra guest above the base occupancy. The nightly rate already includes electricity, piped gas, water, Wi-Fi, the final cleaning fee, bed linen, towels, and all taxes. There is no separate cleaning fee. Extra guests are charged PKR 2,000 per guest per night. Please check the house manual for more details.

| Travel cot, high chair, extra heater, plug adapters | Free |"},{"source_id":"2.4","title":"Security deposit (direct bookings only)","text":"House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.4 Security deposit (direct bookings only)

For **direct bookings** (booked with us and not through a platform) we collect a refundable security deposit of **PKR 25,000**. Pay it by bank transfer or mobile wallet (Easypaisa or JazzCash) at least 24 hours before arrival. The host sends the payment details. After you check out and we inspect the apartment, the deposit is refunded to the same account within **3 business days**, minus the cost of any damage or fees described in section 11.7.

For bookings made through **Airbnb or Booking.com** we do not collect a deposit. The platform's own damage-protection rules apply instead."},{"source_id":"2.2","title":"Extra guest fee","text":"House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.2 Extra guest fee

If the number of guests is above the base occupancy of the apartment, an extra guest fee of **PKR 2,000 per extra guest per night** applies, up to the maximum occupancy. For example, three guests in the One-Bedroom (base 2) pay one extra guest fee each night, and five guests in the Two-Bedroom (base 4) pay one extra guest fee each night. The Studio has no extra guest fee because its base and maximum are both 2."},{"source_id":"11.7","title":"Damage and loss","text":"House manual > 11. House Rules > 11.7 Damage and loss

Please report breakages straight away. Accidental breakage of small items (a glass or plate) is not a problem if you tell us. Larger damage or missing items are charged at replacement cost; for direct bookings this is deducted from the security deposit, and for platform bookings we claim through the platform. We take photos of every apartment before each stay."}]
